# AI agency for marketing, sales and operations. Production house. Incubator.

t&f automates the manual work of marketing, sales and operations with AI agents, makes the realistic media, UGC, influencer campaigns and personal brands that go with it, and backs ventures through Incube8 with training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding.

tests&funnels (t&f) is a Delhi AI agency that automates marketing, sales and operations with AI agents, a production house for realistic media, UGC, influencer marketing and personal branding, and a partner in Incube8, an incubator offering training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding. Agency clients deal with one point of contact.

Built for e-commerce brands, hospitals and clinics, and personal brands.

Building a venture? Learn about [Incube8](https://testsandfunnels.com/incubation/), the incubator we are a partner in.

Brands that have worked with us include:

## One team, one point of contact

### One point of contact

Fewer people managing the operations means fewer people for you to manage. You talk to a single person, not a separate contact for content, ads, leads and reports.

### Less on execution, more on media

With agents handling the repetitive work, less of your budget goes into execution and more into advertising and media creation.

### Every stage measured

We track impressions, clicks, leads, sales and revenue, so every marketing rupee can be traced to what it produced.

## Who we work with

We focus on three niches, so the audit and the strategy start from how your customers actually search, decide and buy.

### E-commerce brands

From first ad to repeat order.

We connect ads, landing pages, your store and product content, so every rupee of spend can be traced to revenue.

[E-commerce marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/e-commerce/)

### Hospitals and clinics

Easy to find, easy to trust, easy to book.

We make your hospital or clinic visible where patients search, and follow up on every enquiry.

[Healthcare marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/healthcare/)

### Personal brands

Turn an audience into enquiries.

We position the person, produce the content and run the funnel that turns attention into qualified enquiries.

[Personal branding](https://testsandfunnels.com/personal-branding/)

## Test everything. Build the funnel around what wins.

### tests

Smart experimentation. We run A/B and multivariate tests and analyze the data to find what works in ads, landing pages and messaging, so performance keeps improving and ROI keeps growing.

### funnels

The customer journey is no longer a straight line, and every business needs a funnel built around its own ideal customer, value proposition and challenges. We turn impressions into clicks, and clicks into loyal customers, with minimal friction.

1.  Impressions
2.  Clicks
3.  Leads
4.  Sales
5.  Revenue

We track every stage, so every marketing rupee can be measured.

The funnel is the same. Our agents run the operations around it, so you deal with one person, not a team.

## How we work: four steps from brief to roadmap

You always know what happens next.

1.  ### We collect your brief

    We start from your business and your goals, in your words.

2.  ### We audit your industry and your funnel

    A full-funnel audit, from visibility to lead capture, nurturing, management and retention.

3.  ### We pitch a strategy and action plan

    We present the plan that fixes the gaps the audit found, including which manual steps our agents take over first.

4.  ### We share the prerequisites and roadmap

    You get what we need from you, and the roadmap for onboarding and executing the strategy.

### What the audit looks at

It starts with your industry: the market, your competitors and your customer segments. Then it follows the customer through five stages and marks which steps are still done by hand.

- **Visibility** Can the right people find you?
- **Lead capture** Do visits turn into enquiries?
- **Nurturing** Are leads followed up well and fast?
- **Management** Are leads and sales tracked and handled?
- **Retention** Do customers come back and recommend you?

[See the full process](https://testsandfunnels.com/how-we-work/)

Our Performance Marketing Training Program, online live or in-office and with AI in every module, teaches the way we work. Master strategies, run campaigns and drive measurable growth.

- Learn
- Execute
- Scale

[Explore the training program](https://testsandfunnels.com/training/)

## Questions before you ask for an audit

### What does t&f do?

t&f is three things under one roof: an AI agency that automates marketing, sales and operations with AI agents; a production house for realistic media, UGC, influencer marketing and personal branding; and a partner in Incube8, an incubator that offers training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding.

### What does t&f automate with AI?

Marketing: scripting, content calendars, production plans, video editing, publishing, insights review, influencer outreach, comment and response management, and ad setup, optimization and reporting. Sales: lead generation and management, follow-up and tele-calling workflows. Operations: MIS and lead dashboards, reporting and planning. People at t&f set the strategy and review what goes live. We build on Claude, Higgsfield and ChatGPT.

### Do you only automate, or do you make the media too?

Both. Photography, videography, graphics, UGC and AI visuals are produced for your ads and channels, and agents handle scripting, planning and editing around them, so more of your budget goes into the media itself and less into managing its production.

### Who will I talk to?

One person. You talk to a single point of contact at t&f, who coordinates the agents and our team, so you are not managing separate people for content, ads, leads and reporting.

### Who stays in control of my ad spend and customer messages?

You and our team do. Agents work within limits you approve, such as budgets, audiences and message templates. People at t&f review what goes live and take the conversations that need a person.

### Is t&f also an incubator?

t&f is a partner in Incube8, an incubator backed by VivoCorp and GeMTech PARAS. It offers training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding to ventures. See the Incube8 page for who it is for and how to apply.

### Which industries do you work in?

E-commerce brands, hospitals and clinics, and personal brands. Personal branding, influencer marketing and UGC are also available on their own.

# AI agents that automate marketing, sales and operations

t&f is an AI automation agency in Delhi. Our agents handle the repetitive work across your marketing, your sales follow-up and your day-to-day reporting. You deal with one point of contact at t&f, and your budget goes into strategy and media, not coordination.

AI automation at t&f means agents that script, schedule, publish, set up and optimize ads, follow up leads, report, and keep dashboards current, working within limits you approve. People at t&f set the strategy and review what goes live.

## Agents do the repeat work

One person at t&f coordinates the agents and our team. Agents handle scripting, scheduling, follow-up and reporting inside limits you approve.

- Marketing, sales and operations agents
- Human review before anything goes live
- Reports that stay current

## What changes for you

### One point of contact

Fewer people managing the operations means fewer people for you to manage. You talk to a single contact, not one person for content, one for ads, one for leads and one for reports.

### Less spent on execution

With fewer people managing the operations, less of your budget goes into execution.

### More into advertising and media

That budget goes into advertising and media creation instead.

## Three areas we automate

### Marketing

Agents that script, plan, publish and advertise. See the [social media agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/social-media-agents/) and the [advertising agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/advertising-agents/). Websites and landing pages are built with agents too: [website development](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/website-development/).

- Scripting, content calendar and production plan
- Video editing, publishing and insights
- Influencer outreach and ORM
- Ads setup, optimization and reporting

### Sales

Agents that bring leads in and follow them up until a person takes over.

- Lead generation and management
- Follow-up by email and WhatsApp
- Tele-calling workflows

[Sales agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/sales-agents/)

### Operations

Agents that keep the numbers and the plans current, so nobody rebuilds the report every week.

- MIS and lead dashboard
- Reporting
- Production and order planning

[Operations agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/operations-agents/)

## Agents do the repetitive work. People stay in control.

### What the agents do

They take the steps that repeat every week: drafting, scheduling, publishing, setting up and tuning campaigns, following up leads, compiling reports and updating dashboards.

### What stays with people

- Agents work within limits you approve, such as budgets, audiences and message templates.
- Your point of contact at t&f sets the strategy and reviews what goes live.
- Conversations that need a person are taken by a person.

## The AI we build on

- Claude
- Higgsfield
- ChatGPT

We build on Claude, Higgsfield and ChatGPT and choose the tool for each task.

## Not sure what to automate first?

Our audit follows your customer from visibility to retention and marks which steps are still done by hand and could move to an agent. You get a plan that starts with the highest-effort steps, not a rebuild of everything at once.

## Questions about AI automation

### How is this different from a regular digital marketing agency?

A regular agency staffs each task with a person. We run the repetitive tasks with agents and keep people on strategy and review, so you manage one contact and less of your budget goes into execution.

### Will AI-written content sound generic?

Agents draft, and people review what goes live against your brand voice and the message templates you approve. Your point of contact owns the strategy, not the tool.

### Do I have to automate everything at once?

No. The audit marks which manual steps to move to agents first, and we begin there.

### Can AI agents automate sales and operations, not just marketing?

Yes. Sales agents handle lead capture, follow-up and the workflows around tele-calls. Operations agents keep MIS, lead dashboards, reports and plans current. Each starts from the steps the audit marks as manual.

## Find out what your agents could take over

Tell us about your business. We start with your brief, then audit your funnel and mark the manual steps.

# Social media agents: from script to published post

Our eight AI social media agents run the whole workflow, so your channels stay active and your team is not chasing scripts, schedules and replies.

Our social media agents write scripts, plan the content calendar and production, edit video, publish on schedule, review performance, reach out to influencers and manage comments, within limits you approve.

## Eight agents, one workflow

### Scripting

Writes scripts for your videos, reels and posts in your brand voice, ready for review.

### Content calendar

Plans what is published and when, across your channels.

### Production plan

Lines up the shoots and assets the calendar needs, so production is planned before it is booked.

### Video editing

Edits your video content so it is ready to publish.

### Publisher

Publishes to your channels on schedule.

### Insights and data reviewer and optimizer

Reviews the performance data and tunes what goes out next.

### Influencer outreach

Reaches out to influencers on your behalf. See [influencer marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/influencer-marketing/).

### ORM

Manages comments and responses on your channels. Conversations that need a person are passed to one.

## What you approve

- The content calendar and the topics it covers.
- The message templates the ORM agent replies from.
- Anything that makes a claim, especially in healthcare, which is checked by a person before it goes live.

Your point of contact at t&f reviews what goes live. The agents do the drafting and the repeating; they do not decide your strategy.

## Questions about social media agents

### Can the publisher post without my approval?

It publishes what has been approved. The calendar and the content are reviewed by your point of contact at t&f before they go out, and you set the limits the agents work within.

### Do agents reply to comments on their own?

The ORM agent handles comments and responses within templates you approve. Conversations that need a person are taken by a person.

# Advertising agents for setup, optimization and reporting

Our AI advertising agents split the work: one sets up and keeps optimizing your campaigns, another reports on how your ads perform, stage by stage, from impressions to revenue.

Our advertising agents set up campaigns on Google, Meta and LinkedIn, keep optimizing them, and report on performance. You set the budget and audience limits; your point of contact at t&f reviews what goes live.

## Two agents, one job: ROI-positive ads

### Ads setup and optimizer

Sets up your campaigns and keeps optimizing them.

- Campaign and audience setup
- A/B and multivariate tests on ads, landing pages and messaging
- Ongoing optimization within your budget

### Ad reporting

Reports on how your ads are performing.

- Tracks the funnel: impressions, clicks, leads, sales, revenue
- Shows what each rupee of spend produced

## Where the agents run ads

- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- LinkedIn Ads

The same agents work from the same funnel, so what you learn on one platform informs the next test. Strategy, budgets and creative direction stay with your point of contact and you. See [performance marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/performance-marketing/) for how the campaigns are planned.

## Questions about advertising agents

### Who sets the ad budget?

You do. The agents work inside the budget and audience limits you approve, and your point of contact reviews what goes live.

### How do the agents test ads?

They run A/B and multivariate tests on ads, landing pages and messaging, and the results decide what runs next. This is the tests half of tests&funnels.

# Sales agents: every lead followed up, from first touch

Our AI sales agents bring leads in, follow them up on email and WhatsApp and run the workflows around tele-calls, so no enquiry waits for someone to remember it.

Our sales agents handle lead generation and management, follow-up by email and WhatsApp, and the workflows around tele-calls, so you can see which leads came from where and what happened to them.

## Three jobs, one lead list

### Lead generation and management

Brings leads in and keeps them organized.

- Capture from ads, forms and enquiries
- One list, not five

### Follow-up

Keeps every enquiry moving.

- Email and WhatsApp follow-up
- Follow-up that does not depend on memory

### Tele-calls

Tele-calling workflows around your leads.

- Who to call and when
- Notes and outcomes recorded against the lead

## Where leads get lost

- **Lead capture:** visits that never become enquiries.
- **Nurturing:** enquiries followed up late or not at all.
- **Management:** leads and sales not tracked in one place.
- **Retention:** customers who never hear from you again.

Our audit checks each stage and shows where you are losing leads and revenue. For human follow-up, see [sales services](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/sales-services/). The numbers from these agents feed the [operations agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/operations-agents/).

## Questions about sales agents

### Do the agents call my leads?

The tele-call agents run the workflows around calling your leads. People take the conversations that need a person.

### Can agents replace my sales team?

No. Agents handle the repetitive follow-up and the workflows around calls. People take the conversations that need a person, and our sales services cover hands-on lead conversion and training.

## See where your leads are leaking

The audit follows your leads from visibility to retention and shows the stage where you lose the most.

# Operations agents: reports, dashboards and plans that stay current

Operations automation with agents: they compile the MIS, keep the lead and order dashboards up to date and line up the production plan, so nobody rebuilds the report every week.

Our operations agents keep the MIS and lead dashboard current with your sales team, report on ad performance, plan production, and keep order and customer tracking dashboards up to date.

## What the operations agents do

### MIS and lead dashboard

Kept current together with your sales team.

- Leads by source
- Follow-up status
- From first touch to close

### Reporting

Reports that follow the funnel, stage by stage.

- Impressions, clicks, leads, sales and revenue
- What each rupee of spend produced

### Production and order planning

Plans that turn the calendar or the order book into work.

- Shoots and assets lined up before they are booked
- Orders assigned to the people who will make them

### Order and customer tracking

One record from customer to order to item.

- Customer, order and item linked
- Payments received and pending calculated
- Each item assigned to one team member

## Operations in practice

For [Suit Up by Kailash Talreja](https://testsandfunnels.com/work/suit-up-by-kailash-talreja/), a Delhi bespoke tailor, the order dashboard links each customer to their orders and each garment to the team member making it, and calculates what has been paid and what is pending.

## Questions about operations agents

### What counts as operations automation?

The repeating back-office work around marketing and sales: MIS, lead and order dashboards, reporting and planning. The audit marks which of these steps are still done by hand and could move to an agent.

### What is in the MIS and lead dashboard?

It tracks leads from first touch to close: where each came from, what follow-up has happened and what the outcome was, kept current with your sales team.

# Market research agent: your market, competitors and customers, with sources

Our AI market research agent gathers what is publicly known about your market, your competitors and your customers, and summarizes it with a source for every finding, so strategy starts from evidence instead of guesses.

Our market research agent researches your market, competitors, customer segments and benchmark metrics, the same inputs as the industry part of our audit, and lists the source of every finding. A person at t&f checks the sources and the conclusions before they shape a strategy.

## What the agent researches

### Market and category

How your category is searched, talked about and bought.

- What customers search for and ask
- Trends and seasonality in the category
- Where the demand sits: channels and regions

### Competitors

Who you are up against and how they present themselves.

- Positioning, offers and pricing pages
- Ads they run in public ad libraries
- Their content, reviews and gaps

### Customer segments

Who buys, why, and what stops them.

- Segments and the problems each one has
- Questions and objections from reviews and comments
- The words customers use, for ads and pages

### Benchmark metrics

Comparison points for your own numbers.

- Published benchmarks, each with its source
- Your own data next to them, where you share it
- Marked as an estimate where no source exists

## Where the research goes next

### Into the audit

It is the industry part of the Free Business Audit, the first thing the audit looks at.

[Auditing agent](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/auditing-agent/)

### Into the tests

Findings become hypotheses for ads, pages and messages. The tests decide what is true for your customers.

[Advertising agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/advertising-agents/)

### Into validation

For ventures in Incube8, it frames what to test on demand, positioning and unit economics before real customer data does the rest.

[Incube8](https://testsandfunnels.com/incubation/)

## Research you can check

- Every finding lists where it came from, so you can open the source yourself.
- Estimates are labelled as estimates.
- A person at t&f reads the summary, checks the sources and decides what goes into your strategy.
- Research gives the hypotheses; tests with your real customers decide.

## Questions about the market research agent

### Where does the market research agent get its information?

From public sources such as search results, competitors' websites, public ad libraries, reviews, social comments and published reports, plus any sales or CRM data you share. Each finding lists its source.

### Can AI market research replace talking to customers?

No. It narrows down what to ask and what to test. What customers actually do, in tests and in real sales data, is what decides the strategy.

### Related

- [All AI agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/)
- [Auditing agent](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/auditing-agent/)
- [Industries](https://testsandfunnels.com/industries/)
- [Incube8](https://testsandfunnels.com/incubation/)

## Start with research on your market

Request the audit. The research on your industry and competitors is where it begins.

# Auditing agent: every stage of your funnel checked, manual steps marked

Our AI auditing agent runs the checks behind the Free Business Audit, from your visibility to your retention, and marks which steps are still done by hand, so the audit report reaches you faster and covers every stage.

Our auditing agent runs the checks behind the Free Business Audit: your industry, visibility, lead capture, nurturing, management and retention, and it marks which steps are still done by hand and could move to an agent. A person at t&f reviews the findings and presents the strategy.

## What the auditing agent checks

| Stage        | What the agent checks                                                                                                                                             |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Industry     | Market, competitors, customer segments and benchmark metrics, from the [market research agent](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/market-research-agent/). |
| Visibility   | Search results, AI answers, ad accounts, social profiles and local listings.                                                                                      |
| Lead capture | Landing pages, forms, offers, page speed, tracking and conversion events.                                                                                         |
| Nurturing    | Email and WhatsApp follow-up, automations and how fast enquiries get a reply.                                                                                     |
| Management   | How leads are handled and tracked, the CRM and the reporting.                                                                                                     |
| Retention    | Repeat purchase or re-engagement, reviews and loyalty.                                                                                                            |

## What you get

### An audit report

The gaps at each stage, with what was checked and what was found.

### The manual steps

Which steps are still done by hand and which could move to an agent first.

### A starting point

The strategy and action plan start from the report. See [how we work](https://testsandfunnels.com/how-we-work/).

## Agent checks, people decide

### What the agent does

It runs the same checks on every stage, every time, and drafts the findings. The same checks can be run again after changes, so you compare against the first audit.

### What stays with people

- Your brief, collected by a person before the audit starts.
- Reviewing every finding and adding what only a conversation can uncover.
- The strategy and action plan we pitch from the report.

## Questions about the auditing agent

### Is the Free Business Audit done by an AI agent?

The agent runs the checks and drafts the findings. A person at t&f collects your brief first, reviews the findings, adds what only a conversation can uncover and presents the strategy.

### What access does the auditing agent need?

Public checks, such as search, AI answers, social profiles and your website, need none. For ad accounts, analytics, Tag Manager or a CRM we ask for read access, and only where the audit needs it.

- [Free Business Audit](https://testsandfunnels.com/free-business-audit/)
- [How we work](https://testsandfunnels.com/how-we-work/)
- [Market research agent](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/market-research-agent/)

## Put your funnel through the audit

# Web development and SEO agent: pages built to rank, answer and convert

Our AI web development and SEO agent builds and maintains your pages and makes them easy to find in Google, in direct answers and in AI-generated answers (SEO, AEO, AIO and GEO), with tracking set up from day one.

Our web development and SEO agent builds websites and landing pages, keeps them fast and tracked, and does the technical SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI search optimization (AIO and GEO) work: titles, structured data, direct answers and files for AI crawlers. People review every page before it goes live.

## Two jobs, one agent

### Web development

Pages that are ready when the campaign is.

- Websites and landing pages on WordPress, Shopify or custom HTML
- Fast loading on mobile
- Tag Manager and analytics events set up before launch
- Landing page variations to test against each other

### SEO, AEO, AIO and GEO

Pages that search engines and AI answer engines can read, quote and attribute.

- Technical SEO: titles, descriptions, internal links, sitemaps
- Structured data (schema) for your business and pages
- A direct answer at the top of each page
- llms.txt, Markdown copies and AI crawler rules

## SEO, AEO, AIO and GEO in plain words

This site is built the same way: every page has a direct answer under its heading, structured data, a Markdown copy and an entry in llms.txt. For the strategy side, see [visibility optimization](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/visibility-optimization/).

| Term | What it means                                                            | What the agent does                                                              |
|------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| SEO  | Ranking in search results                                                | Technical fixes, page titles, internal links and content structure               |
| AEO  | Being the direct answer in search and voice                              | Short answers and FAQs written so they can be lifted whole                       |
| AIO  | Appearing in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode                             | Clear, sourced pages that are easy to summarize                                  |
| GEO  | Being named and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot | Consistent facts about your business, structured data and files AI crawlers read |

## Measured, every month

- Rankings and clicks from Search Console.
- A monthly check of the questions your customers would ask AI engines, recording whether you are mentioned, cited or neither.
- Visits from AI engines tracked as their own channel in GA4.
- Wrong facts in AI answers fixed at the page they come from.

No one can promise rankings or AI citations, and we do not. We show the work and the measurement.

## Questions about the web development and SEO agent

### What is the difference between AIO and GEO?

AIO is about appearing in Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode. GEO is about being understood and cited by generative AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot. The same clear, structured, sourced pages help with both.

### Can an AI agent build my whole website?

Agents handle much of the build: pages, technical SEO, structured data and tracking. People set the structure and the design, and review every page before it goes live.

# Outreach agent: cold outreach that starts real conversations

Our AI outreach agent builds prospect lists around your ideal customer, writes personalised first messages and follow-ups on email, WhatsApp and social DMs, and logs every reply, so your team spends its time on prospects who answered.

Our outreach agent runs B2B cold outreach: it sources prospects that match your ideal customer, sends personalised messages and follow-ups on email, WhatsApp and social DMs within each channel's rules, and logs replies in your CRM, aiming for booked demos. Conversations that need a person go to a person.

## From list to booked demo

1.  ### Data sourcing

    Lists built around your ideal customer, with a record of where each contact came from.

2.  ### Personalisation

    A first message written for the segment, with a line about the prospect's own business.

3.  ### Sequences

    Follow-ups spaced out, and stopped the moment someone replies or opts out.

4.  ### Channels

    Email, WhatsApp and social DMs, chosen by where your buyers respond.

5.  ### CRM logging

    Every send, reply and outcome recorded against the contact.

6.  ### Demo booking

    The goal of every sequence: a conversation on the calendar.

## Outreach that stays within the rules

- Each channel's rules are followed, including WhatsApp's business messaging rules.
- Every message gives a way to opt out, and opt-outs are honoured straight away.
- Where each contact came from is recorded. Check your consent notice against India's DPDP Act with your own adviser.
- You approve the segments, the message templates and a sample of messages before launch.

## After the reply

### Sales agents

Interested replies move to follow-up and tele-call workflows.

[Sales agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/sales-agents/)

### Your team

Conversations that need a person are passed to one, with the history attached.

[Sales services](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/sales-services/)

### Influencer outreach

Outreach to creators is run by the social media agents as part of a campaign.

[Social media agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/social-media-agents/)

## Questions about the outreach agent

### How personal are the messages an outreach agent sends?

Each first message is written for the segment and refers to something specific about the prospect's business. You approve the templates and a sample before anything is sent.

### What happens when a prospect replies?

The reply is logged in your CRM and the sequence stops for that contact. Interested prospects move to follow-up, and conversations that need a person are passed to one.

- [All AI agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/)

# Graphic design agent: on-brand creatives, in every size you need

Our AI graphic design agent makes ad creatives, social posts, carousels, thumbnails and banners from your brand guidelines, in the variations your tests need and the sizes each placement needs, and a person reviews every design before it is used.

Our graphic design agent makes static ad creatives, social posts, carousels, thumbnails, banners and page graphics in your brand style, resized for each placement and varied for A/B tests. It works from your brand guidelines, and a person at t&f reviews every design before it is used.

## What the agent designs

### Ad creatives

Static ads for Meta, Google and LinkedIn.

- Variations of headline, image and offer for A/B tests
- Built from ads that already work
- Handed to the advertising agents to run

### Social posts and carousels

Posts planned in the content calendar.

- Single posts, carousels and story frames
- Templates that keep the feed consistent
- Scheduled by the social media agents

### Thumbnails and covers

The first frame people see.

- YouTube thumbnails and Reel covers
- Readable at small sizes
- Tested where the platform allows

### Website and landing page graphics

Visuals for the pages your ads land on.

- Banners, section graphics and icons
- Compressed for fast loading
- Matched to the campaign the page belongs to

## One design, every placement

- 1:1 feed
- 4:5 feed
- 9:16 stories and reels
- 16:9 video and web
- Banners

Each approved design is resized for every placement it will run in, so the text, logo and product stay inside the safe area on each one.

## How we keep it on brand and safe

- The agent works from your brand guidelines: logo, colours, fonts and templates.
- A person reviews every design before it goes into an ad or a post.
- Products are checked against the real product, so colours and details are accurate.
- AI-generated imagery is labelled where platform rules require it.
- For doctors, clinics and hospitals, we do not use AI imagery to show patients or treatment results.

Where the exact look of a product matters, we recommend a shoot: see [AI visuals and video](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ai-visuals-and-video/) for when to use AI and when to shoot.

## Questions about the graphic design agent

### Does a graphic design agent replace a designer?

It handles first drafts, variations and resizing, which is most of the repeat work. A designer at t&f sets the direction and reviews every design before it is used.

### What if my brand has no guidelines?

We put them together first, as part of brand building: logo use, colours, fonts and a few templates. The agent then works from those.

# Video editing agent: raw footage to reels, ads and cut-downs

Our AI video editing agent turns footage from shoots, UGC creators and screen recordings into reels, ad cuts and longer edits, with captions, music and your brand elements, in every format the channels need.

Our video editing agent cuts raw footage into reels, ads and longer edits: it trims, adds captions, music and brand elements, and makes a 16:9 master with 9:16 and other cut-downs, plus hook and length variations for testing. A person at t&f reviews every cut before it is published.

## What the agent edits

### Reels and shorts

Short-form video for Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

- Tight cuts with a hook in the first seconds
- Captions burned in
- Covers from the graphic design agent

### Ad cuts

Versions of one ad for testing.

- Different hooks, lengths and captions
- Cut for each placement
- Results decide which version runs

### Longer edits

Brand films, explainers, podcasts and founder videos.

- A 16:9 master
- 9:16 and 1:1 cut-downs from the same footage
- Clips for the content calendar

## From footage to published

1.  ### Footage in

    From our [production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/), [UGC](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ugc/) creators, your phone or screen recordings.

2.  ### First cut

    The agent selects takes, trims, and adds captions, music and brand elements.

3.  ### Review

    A person at t&f checks the cut against the brief, the brand and the platform's rules.

4.  ### Every format, then live

    The approved cut is exported for each placement and handed to the [social media agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/social-media-agents/) to publish, or the advertising agents to run.

## Rights and review

- Music and stock footage come from sources licensed for where the video will run.
- Creators and people on camera have agreed to how the footage is used.
- Paid collaborations are disclosed on screen and in the caption.
- Nothing is published until a person has reviewed the final cut.

## Questions about the video editing agent

### What footage can the video editing agent work with?

Footage from our own shoots, UGC creators, phone videos you record, screen recordings and existing brand videos. Longer footage can be cut into many short clips.

### Can it make several versions of one ad for testing?

Yes. It cuts the same footage into versions with different hooks, lengths and captions, and the test results decide which version keeps running.

The production plan says which is which, asset by asset.

- Concept testing before a shoot is booked.
- Variations of an ad that already works.
- Scenes that are costly or slow to shoot.

### A shoot suits

- Products where the exact look must be accurate.
- Brand footage you will reuse for a long time.
- Anything that must show a real place, person or result.

- A person reviews every AI visual before it goes into an ad.
- Product, brand and colour accuracy are checked against the real product.

- For hospitals and clinics, we do not use AI visuals to show patients or treatment results.

## Questions about AI visuals and video

Platforms set rules on AI-generated content in ads, including labelling in some cases. We check the current rules for each platform before anything goes live.

### Can AI visuals replace a shoot?

Sometimes, for concepts and variations. Where the exact look of the product matters, we recommend a shoot, and the production plan says which assets are which.

# UGC for brands: creator-style content that fits your ads and your feed

t&f is a UGC agency for brands: video and photos made in the natural, first-person style audiences trust, briefed from your goal, reviewed before they go live and cut into the formats your ads need.

t&f produces UGC: creator-style video and photos for ads and social. We write the brief and script, shortlist and brief the creators, review the content for your brand and for advertising rules, and edit it into the cuts your channels need.

## UGC, influencer content and studio ads compared

|            | UGC                                     | Influencer content                                  | Studio production                            |
|------------|-----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Looks like | A customer or creator talking to camera | A creator's own post, in their voice                | A designed, lit and directed ad              |
| Runs as    | Your ads and your channels              | The creator's channel, and as an ad with permission | Your ads, website and store                  |
| Suits      | Testing many hooks and angles quickly   | Reach to an existing audience                       | Brand footage you will reuse for a long time |

Most brands use more than one. See [influencer marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/influencer-marketing/) and the [product and lifestyle shoots](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/product-and-lifestyle-shoots/).

## How we run UGC

1.  ### Brief and script

    We start from the goal, the audience and the claim you want to make. Agents draft scripts and hooks, and a person reviews them.

2.  ### Creators

    We shortlist creators for fit with your audience. A person reviews the shortlist and briefs each creator, including disclosure and usage rights.

3.  ### Review

    Every video is checked against your brand and the advertising rules before it goes live.

4.  ### Cut and test

    We edit the content into the cut-downs your ads need and test hooks and angles against each other.

## Rights and disclosure

- Usage rights are agreed in the brief, including where and for how long the content can run as an ad.
- Paid collaborations are disclosed under ASCI's influencer advertising guidelines.
- For hospitals and clinics, no patient data and no treatment-outcome claims.

## Questions about UGC

### What is UGC?

UGC means user-generated content: content made by customers or creators in a natural, first-person style, rather than a studio ad. Brands use it in ads and on social because audiences tend to trust it more than polished brand creative.

### Can UGC run as a paid ad?

Yes, with the creator's permission, and usage rights are agreed in the brief. On Meta, partnership ads let a brand run an ad through a creator's handle.

### How many UGC videos do I need?

Enough to test several hooks and angles against each other. The plan sets the number from your goal and your budget, and the results decide which ones to make more of.

- [Production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/)
- [Influencer marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/influencer-marketing/)

- [Performance marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/performance-marketing/)

## How we work

1.  ### Brief and audit

    We look at your current presence, your audience and your goals.

2.  ### Position

    We set the positioning and the message you will repeat.

3.  ### Produce

    We build the content system: scripts, shoots, edits and a calendar.

4.  ### Distribute and measure

    We publish, add creators and search visibility, and track every enquiry.

## Questions about personal branding

### Who is personal branding for?

Founders, professionals, experts and masters of a craft who win clients on their name, and ventures built around one person.

### What is influencer creation?

Building a person into a creator: a clear position, a content format they can repeat, direction on camera and a production and publishing system, so their audience grows around what they know.

### Which channels do you focus on?

Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and Google, including AI search, because that is where most personal brands are found and judged.

### Will the content sound like me?

Scripts and posts are drafted in your voice, and you approve them before they go out.

### How do you measure a personal brand?

By qualified enquiries and audience growth, not likes alone, with each enquiry tracked from first touch.

# Influencer marketing that is briefed, tracked and reported

t&f is an influencer marketing agency in Delhi. We find the right creators for your audience, reach out, brief them and track what each collaboration produces, so influencer spend is measured like any other channel.

t&f runs influencer marketing from shortlist to report: goal and audience, creator shortlisting and outreach, briefs and approvals, and tracking of clicks, leads and sales for each creator.

## From shortlist to report

1.  ### Define the goal

    What the campaign must produce, and who it must reach.

2.  ### Shortlist and reach out

    Our influencer outreach agent reaches out on your behalf. A person reviews the shortlist.

3.  ### Brief and approve

    Every brief covers disclosure under ASCI's influencer advertising guidelines, and content is approved before it goes live.

4.  ### Track and report

    Links and codes per creator show clicks, leads and sales, so you see what each collaboration produced.

## Formats we run

- Paid collaborations
- Product seeding
- Creator content reused in ads

Creator content can run as ads too. On Meta, partnership ads let a brand run ads through a creator's handle, with the creator's permission. See the [production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/) for how we plan content for reuse.

## Healthcare and regulated categories

Advertising rules limit what a creator can say about healthcare. For hospitals and clinics we keep creator content to education and awareness, with no patient data or treatment-outcome claims.

## Questions about influencer marketing

### How are creators chosen?

By fit with your audience and your goal, and by the quality of their content. A person reviews the shortlist before anyone is contacted.

### How do you measure influencer campaigns?

Each creator gets their own link or code, so clicks, leads and sales can be traced to the creator and the post.

### Can influencer content be used in my ads?

Yes, with the creator's permission, and we agree usage rights in the brief.

# Incube8: an incubator for training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding

Incube8 is a startup incubator in Delhi NCR for ventures that need to test an idea, and ventures with traction that are not yet at the scale to invest in marketing, advertising or sales on their own. t&f is one of three partners behind it.

Incube8 is an incubator and accelerator for ventures from any industry, with a strong suit in medical and hospitals. It offers training, validation, acceleration, office space and funding, and is backed by VivoCorp, GeMTech PARAS and t&f.

## Three partners, three jobs

### VivoCorp

An investment company. Backs the model with capital.

### GeMTech PARAS

A tendering agency that helps ventures with Government tendering business.

### t&f

A marketing and production agency driven by professional marketers and AI agents.

## What incubated ventures get

### Training

Performance marketing, brand and investor-pitch skills for your team, from our [training program](https://testsandfunnels.com/training/).

### Validation

A structured test of demand, positioning and unit economics with real customer data, using the same tests-and-funnels method we run for clients.

### Acceleration

Marketing, advertising, sales and production support from t&f, with ongoing strategy and accountability, so a validated venture can scale.

### Office space

A desk and production-studio access in our Delhi NCR office.

### Funding

Seed and growth capital, structured to your venture's stage.

## Who it is for

### Two ways in

- **Validate:** you have an idea, a prototype or a pilot and want to test demand before you spend.
- **Accelerate:** you have traction but not yet the scale to invest in marketing, advertising or sales on your own.
- Any industry. Our strong suit is medical and hospitals.

### How it works

1.  ### Apply

    Tell us what you are building.

2.  ### We review

    We look at your venture and where it is today.

3.  ### Terms first

    Equity, royalty and commission are structured per venture and set out before any work begins.

## Ventures already built this way

### Incubated by VivoCorp

- VivoSure
- Vivomed
- VivoTech

### Built by t&f

- STEAMED (STEAM education)
- Stickler (D2C)
- Arté Labs (lab infrastructure)

We build our own ventures the same way, with the same team.

## Questions about Incube8

### Who can apply to Incube8?

Ventures from any industry, from an idea or prototype that needs validation to a venture with real traction that needs to accelerate. Medical and hospital ventures are our strong suit.

### What does t&f contribute?

Marketing and production, driven by professional marketers and AI agents, alongside the capital from VivoCorp and the tendering support from GeMTech PARAS.

### What does validation mean in Incube8?

Testing whether customers want what you are building, before you scale it: demand, positioning and unit economics, measured with real customer data.

### Is every application taken forward?

No. We review each application before anything is agreed.

Sales agents follow up leads on email and WhatsApp and run the workflows around tele-calls, and operations agents keep the MIS and lead dashboard current with your sales team.

## Questions about sales services

### What is the difference between lead conversion and sales ops setup?

Lead conversion is the follow-up work on your leads. Sales ops setup builds the CRM, pipeline and reporting so every lead is tracked from first touch to close.

### Do you train in-house sales teams?

Yes: scripts, playbooks, objection-handling frameworks and hands-on coaching.

# Marketing for edtech, coaches and consultants: from first view to enrolled or signed

t&f is a marketing agency for edtech companies, coaches and consultants. We build the authority, the funnel and the follow-up that turn an audience into booked calls, enrolments and signed clients.

t&f runs founder and expert content, lead campaigns on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, webinar, video sales letter and landing page funnels, and follow-up on email and WhatsApp for edtech companies, coaches and consultants, measured by cost per lead, cost per booked call and how many leads enrol or sign.

## Three businesses, one kind of funnel

### Edtech and course creators

People compare options for weeks before they enrol, so the funnel has to teach and follow up.

- Free class, webinar or video sales letter
- Counselling call
- Enrolment, then referrals

### Coaches

People buy the coach before the programme, so trust is built in public first.

- Content that shows how you think
- A lead magnet or free session
- Discovery call, then the programme

### Consultants

Buyers are few and senior, so reach is targeted and every lead gets a person.

- Authority content on LinkedIn
- Targeted outreach to named accounts
- Discovery call, proposal, signed

## What we run

### Founder and expert content

Positioning, scripts and a repeatable content series in your voice.

[Personal branding](https://testsandfunnels.com/personal-branding/)

### Lead campaigns on Meta, Google and LinkedIn

Campaigns built around booked calls and enrolments, not clicks.

[Performance marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/performance-marketing/)

### Webinar, video sales letter and landing pages

The page or session that does the explaining before the call, with tracking from day one.

[Website development](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/website-development/)

### Follow-up and call booking

Every lead followed up on email and WhatsApp, with a call booked and reminders sent.

[Sales agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/sales-agents/)

### Outreach for consultants

Lists built around your ideal client and personalised first messages that aim for a discovery call.

[Outreach agent](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/outreach-agent/)

### Search and AI-answer visibility

So you show up when people search, or ask an AI assistant, for a course, a coach or an adviser.

[Visibility optimization](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/visibility-optimization/)

- Cost per lead

## Claims we keep honest

- No promises of income, jobs, ranks or results that you cannot substantiate.

- Paid partnerships with creators are disclosed.

## Questions from edtech companies, coaches and consultants

### Is a webinar or a video sales letter better for selling a course?

Both can work. We start with the one that fits your price and how much your buyers need to talk to someone before they pay, then test the other.

### Can you market a coach or consultant who has no audience yet?

Yes. Content builds the audience over time, so we run lead campaigns and, for consultants, targeted outreach alongside it, and the calendar does not wait for followers.

### Do you make the ads and the video sales letter?

Yes. Our production house shoots and edits the ads, the content and the video sales letter, and the same team runs the funnel they go into.

# Suit Up by Kailash Talreja: 32.8K followers and 1.5M plays on its latest 12 Reels

A personal branding case study: personal branding and influencer creation for a Delhi bespoke tailor whose family has been tailoring since the 1930s. A master teaches the craft on Instagram, one repeatable series at a time.

t&f built personal branding and influencer creation for Suit Up by Kailash Talreja, a Delhi bespoke tailor whose family has been tailoring since the 1930s. Its Instagram profile has 32.8K followers and its latest 12 Reels have 1.5M plays in total, from public figures read on 12 November 2026.

## Snapshot

|          |                                                                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Client   | Suit Up by Kailash Talreja, a bespoke tailoring house in Delhi. Masterji and family, tailoring since the 1930s. |
| Industry | Bespoke tailoring                                                                                               |
| Service  | Personal branding and influencer creation                                                                       |
| Channel  | Instagram: [@suitupbykailashtalreja](https://www.instagram.com/suitupbykailashtalreja/)                         |
| Website  | [suitupbykailashtalreja.com](https://suitupbykailashtalreja.com/)                                               |

## Results

**32.8K** Instagram followers on 12 Nov 2026, up from about 10K on 26 Sep 2026

**1.5M** Plays across the latest 12 Reels, posted 12 Oct to 11 Nov 2026

**488.1K** Plays on the top Reel of the 12, posted 10 Nov 2026

**10 of 12** Latest Reels with more than 30K plays

Sources: the public Instagram profile and Reels tab of @suitupbykailashtalreja, read on 12 November 2026 (followers, posts and plays), and a screenshot of the profile and Instagram's professional dashboard taken on 26 September 2026 (about 10K followers, 41 posts, 1.8M views in the previous 30 days). The dashboard counts views and the public Reels tab shows plays per Reel, so the 1.8M and the 1.5M are different measures and are not a before and after.

## What the content looks like

- **One teacher, one workbench.** Master Kailash Talreja at the cutting table, explaining one step of cutting or drafting per Reel: the sleeve, the armhole, the pocket, the hem, the front draft, the trouser.
- **Real measurements.** Captions give the actual numbers, such as a 36-inch chest and a 23.5-inch sleeve, so each Reel can be followed on cloth.
- **Short and varied.** The latest 12 Reels run from 19 to 103 seconds.
- **The two Reels above 400K plays** are a cutting rule many tailors skip, and a then-versus-now comparison of the shirt front.
- **The family's craft sayings** are part of the series, passed down from Master Kanhaiya Lal Talreja.

## What we did

### Personal branding and influencer creation

Built the account around one master teaching the craft, in a series he can repeat, and ran the content system behind it.

[Personal branding and influencer creation](https://testsandfunnels.com/personal-branding/)

### Brand identity and collateral

Logo, letterhead, price card, packaging sticker and an interlining label that carries the house's story, so the brand looks the same on the cloth, in the shop and on screen.

### Founder-story video

A video on how Master Kailash Talreja learned the craft, to give the series its backstory.

### Operations dashboard

An order dashboard that links each customer to their orders and each garment to the team member making it, and calculates what is paid and pending.

[Operations agents](https://testsandfunnels.com/ai-automation/operations-agents/)

# Ayurvishwa Healthcare: 815 enquiries and 77 patient visits in April 2025

A healthcare marketing case study: Meta lead campaigns for the clinics and visiting-doctor days of an Ayurveda provider in Maharashtra, reported by clinic from the first enquiry to the patient who walked in.

t&f ran Meta lead campaigns for the clinics and visiting-doctor days of Ayurvishwa Healthcare, an Ayurveda provider in Maharashtra. The campaigns logged 815 enquiries and 77 patient visits in April 2025, per t&f's own campaign reports. No patient details are used or shown.

## Enquiries to visits

Meta lead campaigns for the clinics of an Ayurveda provider. Totals only, no patient data.

## Snapshot

|                |                                                                                                                                          |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Client         | Ayurvishwa Healthcare, an Ayurveda healthcare provider with clinics across Maharashtra                                                   |
| Industry       | Healthcare (Ayurveda)                                                                                                                    |
| Services       | Meta lead campaigns, enquiry tracking, a Google Ads keyword and ad-copy plan, an SEO audit and content plan, and ad and social creatives |
| Where          | Pune, Mumbai, Nashik, Kolhapur, Solapur and other towns across Maharashtra                                                               |
| Period covered | April to July 2025 campaign reports                                                                                                      |

## Results

**815** Enquiries logged in April 2025 across visiting-doctor and standalone clinic campaigns

**221** Enquiries marked qualified, with 69 more marked potential

**77** Patients visited, 14 of them for a consultation only

**₹8.10** Lowest cost per lead on a single ad, a Mumbai clinic Reel in May

Source: tests&funnels' own campaign reports for Ayurvishwa Healthcare. The enquiry, qualification and patient-visit figures are the final summary of the April 2025 report for visiting-doctor and standalone clinic campaigns. Cost per lead is as Meta reported it for each ad in the monthly ad reports for May to July. These are totals only. No patient details are used or shown.

## How the 815 enquiries were sorted

A lead total alone says little about how many people can be booked, so the report shows the status of every enquiry. A little over one in four was marked qualified, and more than four in ten had no status recorded.

| Status in the April report | Enquiries |
|----------------------------|-----------|
| Qualified (yes)            | 221       |
| Qualified (potential)      | 69        |
| Not specific               | 168       |
| Blank, no status recorded  | 357       |
| **Total**                  | **815**   |

## Cost per lead, ad by ad

The May to July ad reports list click-through rate and cost per lead for every ad. The spread between ads is wide.

| Campaign group                                                                              | Cost per lead, lowest to highest ad |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| Mumbai standalone clinic ads                                                                | ₹8.10 to ₹16.22                     |
| Pune standalone clinic ads                                                                  | ₹8.74 to ₹19.10                     |
| Visiting-doctor town ads (Solapur, Satara, Sangli, Nashik, Sambhajinagar, Amravati, Nanded) | ₹8.29 to ₹67.88                     |

Cost per lead is the cost to get an enquiry, not the cost to get a patient. The highest ad cost more than eight times the lowest, which is why the reports break cost down by ad and by clinic.

## What we did

### Meta lead campaigns by clinic

Campaigns built around each outpatient day: a standalone clinic, or a doctor's scheduled visit to a town. Each ad is reported by clinic with click-through rate and cost per lead.

[Performance marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/performance-marketing/)

### Enquiry tracking

Enquiries logged by clinic, sorted as qualified, potential or not specific, and matched to the patients who visited, so spend is judged against visits and not only leads.

[Sales services](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/sales-services/)

### Google Ads plan and SEO audit

A keyword and ad-copy plan for Google Ads covering near-me, treatment and Pune-specific searches, plus a website SEO audit and a content plan for a resource hub.

[Visibility optimization](https://testsandfunnels.com/services/visibility-optimization/)

### Ad and social creatives

Ad and social creatives in English and Marathi, web banners, festival and Doctor's Day posts, and product label artwork.

[Production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/)

## What this page does not claim

- No treatment or health outcomes. The page reports enquiries, visits and cost per lead only.
- No patient data. Every figure is a total.
- No promise of the same numbers for another clinic. Cost per lead varied widely between ads and towns.

## Questions about this case study

### What did tests&funnels do for Ayurvishwa Healthcare?

We ran Meta lead campaigns for its clinics and visiting-doctor days, tracked enquiries through to patient visits, planned Google Ads keywords and ad copy, audited its website for SEO and made ad and social creatives.

### What is a visiting OPD campaign?

In the campaign reports, a visiting OPD is an outpatient day a doctor holds at a branch on a set date, and a standalone OPD is a fixed clinic. A visiting-OPD campaign advertises the day in that town so people can enquire before it.

### Does this case study claim any treatment results?

No. It reports enquiries, qualified enquiries, patient visits and cost per lead. It makes no claim about health outcomes, and it shows no patient data.

### Why were only 221 of 815 enquiries marked qualified?

357 enquiries had no status recorded and 168 were marked not specific. We show the full split because a lead total on its own overstates how many people can be booked.

# Media portfolio: photos, films, UGC and creator content we make

A look at the media our production house makes for brands: product and lifestyle photography, brand films, UGC, influencer content, AI visuals and personal-brand reels, each briefed from a goal and checked before it runs.

t&f's media portfolio shows the media its production house makes for brands: product and lifestyle photography, brand films and ad films, UGC, influencer content, AI visuals and video, and personal-brand reels. Each piece is briefed from a campaign goal, checked for rights and advertising rules, and cut into the formats ads and feeds need.

## Six kinds of media we make

Every piece starts from the goal of a campaign, not from a format. Each type links to the page that explains how we make it.

### Product and lifestyle photography

Product, lifestyle and detail shots planned for the ad formats where they will run.

- Hero, in-use and detail shots
- Planned from a shot list
- Cropped for each placement

[Product and lifestyle shoots](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/product-and-lifestyle-shoots/)

### Brand films and ad films

Short films and cut-downs for your site, your ads and your sales conversations.

- Brand films and explainers
- Ad films with a 16:9 master and 9:16 cut-downs
- Captions burned in

[Production house](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/)

### UGC

Creator-style video and photos that fit your ads and your feed, with usage rights agreed in the brief.

- Product demos and service explainers
- Founder-led videos
- Cut into the formats your ads need

[UGC production](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ugc/)

### Influencer content

Creator campaigns that are briefed, disclosed and reported on.

- Creator reels and stories
- Paid collaborations disclosed
- A report at the end

[Influencer marketing](https://testsandfunnels.com/influencer-marketing/)

### AI visuals and video

Concepts, variations and hard-to-shoot scenes, labelled as AI-generated and reviewed by a person.

- Product and concept visuals
- AI-assisted video
- Reviewed before it runs

[AI visuals and video](https://testsandfunnels.com/production-house/ai-visuals-and-video/)

### Personal-brand content

Reels and posts built around a founder, a professional or a master of a craft.

- A repeatable series
- On-camera direction and scripts in your voice
- Published to a calendar

[Personal branding](https://testsandfunnels.com/personal-branding/)

## From brief to finished media

1.  ### Brief

    We start from the goal, the audience and the claim you want to make, and list where each piece will run.

2.  ### Produce

    We shoot, brief creators or generate visuals to the plan, producing in bulk so one session covers the list.

3.  ### Review

    Every piece is checked against your brand, the advertising rules and its usage rights before it goes live.

4.  ### Cut and deliver

    We edit into the cut-downs and crops each placement needs and deliver files ready to upload.

## Rights, disclosure and review

- Usage rights are agreed in the brief, including where and for how long content can run as an ad.
- Paid collaborations are disclosed under ASCI's influencer advertising guidelines.
- AI-generated visuals and video are labelled as AI-generated and reviewed by a person before they run.
- Client work is shown only with the client's approval. Patient and customer details are blurred or left out.
- For hospitals and clinics: no patient footage and no treatment-outcome claims.

## The numbers behind the media

Media is one half of a campaign. Each case study says what ran, what it produced and where the figures come from.

# How we work: four steps from brief to roadmap

You always know what happens next. Our marketing agency process starts from your brief, not a pitch.

Every engagement follows four steps: we collect your brief, audit your industry and full funnel, pitch a strategy and action plan, and share the prerequisites and the roadmap for onboarding and execution.

## The four steps

| Step                          | What we do                                                                                                              | What you get                                     |
|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| 1\. Brief                     | We collect a brief from you, in your words.                                                                             | A completed client brief                         |
| 2\. Industry and client audit | We audit your industry and your full funnel, from visibility through lead capture, nurturing, management and retention. | An audit report showing the gaps                 |
| 3\. Strategy and action plan  | We pitch the strategy and action plan that fixes the gaps, including which manual steps our agents take over first.     | A strategy presentation and action plan          |
| 4\. Prerequisites and roadmap | We share what we need from you, and the roadmap for onboarding and executing the strategy.                              | A prerequisites checklist and onboarding roadmap |

## The full-funnel audit

| Audit part   | What it checks                                                        |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Industry     | Market, competitors, customer segments and benchmark metrics.         |
| Visibility   | Search (SEO, AEO, GEO), paid ads, social presence and local listings. |
| Lead capture | Landing pages, forms, offers, tracking and conversion events.         |
| Nurturing    | Email and WhatsApp follow-up, automations and response time.          |
| Management   | Lead handling, CRM, follow-up process and reporting.                  |
| Retention    | Repeat purchase or re-engagement, reviews and loyalty.                |

For each stage, the audit also marks which steps are still done by hand and could move to an agent.

## What we typically need from you

- Access to your ad accounts, analytics and Tag Manager.
- Access to your store, website or CRM.
- Your brand assets and guidelines.
- Past campaign and sales data, if you have it.
- One person on your side who can approve work.

The exact list for your business comes at step 4.

## Questions about our process

### What happens after I request the audit?

We contact you to collect your brief first. We then audit your industry and your full funnel, pitch a strategy and action plan to fix the gaps, and share the prerequisites and the roadmap for onboarding and execution.

### Do I need to be running ads already?

No. The audit covers visibility, lead capture, nurturing, management and retention, and the form has an option for businesses that are not running ads yet.

### Where do the AI agents come in?

At step 3. The strategy names which manual steps our agents take over first, so automation starts where it saves the most effort.

- [About tests&funnels](https://testsandfunnels.com/about/)
- [Contact tests&funnels](https://testsandfunnels.com/contact/)

## Start with your brief

Tell us about your business and we take it from there.

# Digital marketing training: the Performance Marketing Training Program

Learn. Execute. Scale. This AI-first performance marketing course covers strategy, running campaigns and driving measurable growth, with AI in every module, taught by the founders of a working performance marketing agency. Attend online live or in the office.

The Performance Marketing Training Program is an AI-first performance marketing course from t&f, taught by the founders of a working agency. It runs 41 sessions and costs ₹40,000 + GST online live or ₹60,000 + GST in the office (6 seats per intake). The next intake starts Monday 7 December 2026 and applications close Friday 27 November 2026.

**Online live ₹40,000 + GST** · **In-office ₹60,000 + GST** · EMI available on major credit cards and HDFC debit cards
Next intake: **Monday 7 December 2026** · 6 in-office seats, online has no cap

## Two ways to attend

### Online live

Live interactive sessions online, so you can attend from anywhere. No cap on online places. ₹40,000 + GST.

### In-office

Attend in person at the [VivoCorp Workspace](https://workspace.vivocorpindia.com). Limited to 6 students per intake, each chosen after a one-on-one interaction. ₹60,000 + GST.

Both formats follow the same curriculum. You choose one when you apply.

## How the program runs

|                     | Details                                                                                                               |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

## AI in every domain

### AI in ads

Use AI to research audiences and competitors, draft and test ad creative and copy, and read performance faster across Meta, Google and LinkedIn.

Use AI for keyword research, content briefs and site audits, and learn how AI search changes visibility through SEO, AIO and GEO.

Use AI to plan content, write scripts and captions, repurpose one idea across formats and read what is working.

Use AI to write and personalize messages, segment a database and set up the automations that nurture leads.

## Performance marketing vs digital marketing

|             | Digital marketing                             | Performance marketing                |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| Focus       | Visibility, awareness and audience engagement | Measurable business outcomes and ROI |
| Measured by | Reach, engagement and followers               | Sales, revenue and ROAS              |

The program teaches both, and trains you to tie each to revenue.

## The tests and funnels method

### tests

Smart experimentation. You run A/B tests through data analysis to find what works in ads, landing pages and messaging, so performance keeps improving and ROI keeps growing.

### funnels

Every business needs a funnel built around its own ideal customer, value proposition and challenges. You learn to turn impressions into clicks, and clicks into loyal customers, with minimal friction.

### How is AI taught in the program?

AI is part of every module: AI in ads, AI in SEO, AI in social media, AI in email and WhatsApp marketing, and AI in digital sales. You practise with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, NotebookLM and Google AI Studio on real campaign work.

### Do I get a certificate?

Yes. Certificates are part of the program.

### Is a job guaranteed?

No. Placement and client-acquisition support covers portfolio building and case studies, interview preparation, client brief collection, 360° marketing strategy and client pitch presentation. It is support, not a job guarantee.

### Which tools will I learn?

Website, analytics, advertising, SEO, CRM and AI tools, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Tag Manager, Shopify, Zoho CRM, ChatGPT and Claude.

### How do I pay, and is EMI available?

The fee is ₹40,000 + GST for online live and ₹60,000 + GST for in-office. EMI is available on major credit cards and on HDFC debit cards, with tenures that depend on your bank.

### What is the refund policy?

Read our [Refund Policy](https://testsandfunnels.com/refund-policy/).

### How long is the program, and when does the next batch start?

The program is 41 sessions of 1 to 2 hours each, about five a week, so it runs inside 2 months. The next intake starts on Monday 7 December 2026 and applications close on Friday 27 November 2026. A new intake starts about every 2 months.

### How many seats are there?

In-office intakes are limited to 6 students, each chosen after a one-on-one interaction. Online has no cap.

### Is there homework?

Yes. Every session ends with a task, usually 1 to 2 hours, that you can do at home or in the office. The next session starts with a review of it.
